SELECT c.id AS chunk_id,c.document_id,c.index_version_id,c.knowledge_base_id, c.content,c.source_start,c.source_end,c.heading_path, c.embedding <=> #{vector,typeHandler=com.lnjecit.knowledge.assistant.infrastructure.persistence.VectorTypeHandler} AS distance FROM document_chunk c JOIN document d ON d.id=c.document_id AND d.knowledge_base_id=c.knowledge_base_id AND d.active_version_id=c.index_version_id JOIN document_index_version v ON v.id=c.index_version_id AND v.document_id=d.id WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{snapshot.knowledgeBaseId} AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL
AND ( (c.document_id=#{entry.documentId} AND c.index_version_id=#{entry.indexVersionId}) ) ORDER BY distance ASC,c.id ASC LIMIT #{topK}
